questions.q: Which worldwide terror network does Grand Master Robo lead?
questions.why: He leads the Robo Army, a global terrorist organisation.

questions.q: Which character is Grand Master Robo's daughter?
questions.why: Natasha, Dhruva's love interest, is the daughter of his arch-enemy.

questions.q: Which side of Grand Master Robo's body is metallic?
What is fitted into one of Grand Master Robo's eyes?
questions.why: A laser eye is built into his left eye.

questions.q: Who created the hero whose arch-enemy is Grand Master Robo?
questions.why: Anupam Sinha created Dhruva and the Robo storyline.

questions.q: In Maut Ka Olympic, what did the winning criminal earn?
options: A seat on the games committee
questions.why: The crime Olympics offered the winner the right to kill the hero.

questions.q: Grand Master Robo is the arch-enemy of which hero?
questions.why: He is Dhruva's most famous recurring enemy.

questions.q: In which city does the crime Olympics of Maut Ka Olympic take place?
questions.why: The criminal games were staged in Dhruva's home city of Rajnagar.
